references.text: Mentions the Rephaim as a people who lived in the area and provides context for who these giants were.
Mentions the Rephaim as one of the peoples living in the land God promised to Abraham.
Parallel text that also describes the Rephaim and how they were called Zamzummim by the Ammonites, just as the Moabites called them Emim.
Mentions the Anakim, the people with whom the Rephaim are compared in the verse.
Describes the Anakim as descendants of the giants (Nephilim) and provides background for the comparison with the Rephaim.
Tells about the destruction of the Anakim from the hill country, which was the people the Rephaim were compared to.
Mentions Og, king of Bashan, as the last of the Rephaim and gives information about their size.
